displayName: CVF Model Gateway C-02 P4C provider adapter contract conformance source
negativeSearchTerms: fetch (not in conformance - no network call)
notes: Provider-agnostic adapter conformance evaluator. Pure local, deterministic, no-network. Exports ProviderAdapterConformanceStatus, ProviderAdapterConformanceInput, ProviderAdapterConformanceReport, evaluateProviderAdapterConformance, and PROVIDER_ADAPTER_CONFORMANCE_VERSION. Uses existing method-gate helpers (findProviderCapability, listRegistrySupportedMethods, normalizeProviderMethodName) and ProviderExecutionAdapter from bridge. liveExecutionAuthorized is always false. adapter.execute() is never called.
